subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.

This building is __colossal __and it can hold a village's population in it.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **very huge**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"colossal"** means something that is extremely large or massive in size. (विशाल)

 
 
• **Example: **The statue of liberty is a colossal monument that attracts millions of visitors each year.
 
 
 
• **"Very huge"** refers to something that is extremely large or enormous in size. (बहुत बड़ा)
 
 
• **Example: **The new shopping mall is very huge, covering an area of several acres.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the meaning of **'colossal'** is **'very huge'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **very huge**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Temporary** (अस्थायी): Lasting for only a limited period of time; not permanent.

 
 
• **Example: **The company hired temporary workers for the busy holiday season.
 
 
 
• **Very beautiful** (बहुत सुंदर): Extremely attractive or pleasing to look at.
 
 
• **Example: **The sunset over the mountains was very beautiful.
 
 
 
• **Puny** (दुर्बल): Small and weak; lacking in size, strength, or power.
 
 
• **Example: **The puny seedlings struggled to grow in the poor soil.
